newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centennial sells bulk of AQC stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centennial sells bulk of AQC stake.

text.p: Centennial Coal Co Ltd said on Friday it had disposed of the majority of its 10 per cent shareholding in Allied Queensland Coalfields Ltd, following the withdrawal of its bid for the company.
Centennial managing director Bob Cameron said in a statement the shares were sold at an average price of 78.15 Australian cents a share, compared with an acquisition cost of 70 cents a share.
"Centennial's bid for AQC of 75 cents per AQC share was at the upper end of our valuation range," Cameron said in a statement.
AQC on Tuesday recommended a rival 78 cents a share bid by Marsford Investments Pte Ltd, a unit of Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd.

"Whilst we were willing buyers at 75 cents, we were not prepared to increase our offer price to the level necessary to overbid Marsford Investments. We believe there is better value elsewhere," Cameron said.
Centennial announced earlier on Friday it had successfully completed a A$20.8 million capital raising which would be used to pursue other expansion opportunities.
